newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Regal Cinemas upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Regal Cinemas upgraded.

text.p: --Hilliard Lyons entertainment analyst Jeffrey Thomison said Wednesday he raised his rating on Regal Cinemas Inc to buy from hold following a decline in the stock price.
--Thomison said he believes the price decline is a result of earnings concerns of some competitors and the issue of potential theatre overcapacity.
--"Regal is highly profitable and should not be viewed in the same light as less efficient operators," Hilliard Lyons said in a release.
--Thomison recommends purchase of Regal with a two-year target price of $36 a share.
--Shares of Regal closed at 25-1/2 on Tuesday.
